slice: Exhaustive ownership state/profile/concurrency matrix and cross-profile mutation fix (slice 2a completion)
boundary: Verified against the exact changed bytes in state-matrix-source-manifest.json. This completes the 2a ownership matrix: every declared job state for both phases, every attempt state, the full checkpoint order, all stop outcomes, profile isolation across read/claim/checkpoint/stop/prepare and same-lease/parallel-profile races.

It fixes a real trusted-layer defect found by the matrix: state.prepare/claim/checkpoint/stop loaded the job through decode_job without the store profile, so a Store opened for another profile could mutate a foreign profile's job. Public Engine reads were already profile-scoped, so this was a defence-in-depth boundary defect in the trusted mutation layer, not a public-route bypass. Every mutation path now passes store.profile and refuses cross-profile jobs.

It does NOT claim executed rule coverage/case-assertion linkage, MT08 adequacy acceptance, a full native/gateway owner journey, or any point 3 row; those remain open (3c and the remaining point 2 obligations). Point 4 remains HOLD.

design.job_state_matrix: For both baseline and candidate phases, an attempt is claimable only in its declared job states (baseline: BASELINE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED; candidate: CANDIDATE_BUILT/CANDIDATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED). All other 20/21 states refuse with state/recovery/active errors, and an allowed claim yields fence >= 1 with attempt state RUNNING.
design.attempt_state_matrix: Claim is allowed only for a PREPARED attempt; RUNNING/CLAIMED/COLLECTED active rows refuse with an active/recovery error and every terminal state refuses replay.
design.checkpoint_matrix: The four labels are accepted in exactly AUTHORITY_CLAIMED → START_REQUESTED → COLLECTED → CLEANUP_VERIFIED order; every out-of-order label refuses, a same-details replay is idempotent, changed details refuse and unknown labels refuse.
design.stop_matrix: FAILED/CANCELLED/INTERRUPTED each terminate the attempt and job; invalid outcomes, empty reasons and unowned leases refuse, and a stopped attempt cannot checkpoint.
design.profile_matrix: Reads, claim, checkpoint, stop and prepare all refuse a foreign-profile job; two profiles can hold independent leases concurrently in one root.
design.concurrency_matrix: Two workers cannot claim one attempt (existing), same-lease same-detail checkpoints are idempotent, same-lease conflicting details race to one winner plus one changed-metadata refusal, and prepare idempotency remains single-identity.
